name: JobDataLake
description:
Search and filter 1M+ enriched job listings from 20,000+ companies. Find jobs by skills, salary, location, seniority, remote type, and more. Includes 5 tools:      
  search jobs, get job details, company profiles, similar jobs, and filter discovery. Free tier with 500 calls/day — no signup or API key needed. Unlimited access     
  available with a paid plan.

_published_faq.name: How do I add JobDataLake to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add JobDataLake to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.jobdatalake.com/.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the JobDataLake MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: JobDataLake provides these MCP tools: search_jobs, get_job, get_company, find_similar_jobs, and get_filter_options.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to JobDataLake?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to JobDataLake in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
JobDataLake does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
JobDataLake is developed by EchoJobs LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
